name: Live extraction — invoice with no emissions data at all
why: The common real case: the supplier sent an ordinary commercial invoice and nothing about emissions. The engine returns the goods line it found and leaves emissions null rather than inventing a zero, which is what makes the default path downstream correct — a fabricated zero would read as a measured zero and select the wrong method. This case also carries the origin-country defect pinned in invoice_steel_two_lines: the text says 'Origin: IN' and origin_country is null.
